component.name: Portfolio Jockey
component.summary: Keep your projects and their files encrypted, on this device only

description.p: Portfolio Jockey keeps track of your projects: a name, a description, tags and the files that belong to each one. Everything is stored encrypted on this device and unlocked with your passphrase.

ul.li: Works fully offline. The app has no network access at all.
No accounts, no telemetry, no analytics and no crash reports.
Preview images, text, Markdown, PDF, audio and video without leaving a readable copy on disk.
Export projects as a passphrase-locked file or as an ordinary ZIP or TAR archive.
